summary: Apple's age-range API returns an age declaration that is set by the Apple Account holder or a Family Sharing parent and confirmed through Apple's own account and payment checks. It needs Apple account and Family Sharing services and an Apple-issued entitlement, and BifrOSt has none of these, so there is no counterpart to build.

features.note: Depends on Apple account and Family Sharing data; BifrOSt Account (bifrost-cloud) has no age declaration
The entitlement is an Apple-issued capability; BifrOSt's own entitlement mechanism is unrelated and has no age data behind it
System sheet for age-related update consent; no BifrOSt counterpart

features.apple: Declared Age Range overview (adults, teens, children)
features.note: Family-level parental controls are not part of BifrOSt; no age data source exists
